name: Foxy Jumpscare
description: Every jump has a chance to black out the screen with a jumpscare.

chance.name: Blackout chance (%)
chance.description: Chance per jump that the screen goes black and the jumpscare plays.

sound-every-jump.name: Sound on every jump
sound-every-jump.description: Off: the sound only plays when the screen goes black. On: the sound plays on every single jump.
